args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

round_money's docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
per FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused
tests/test_money.py's test_half_even to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounded to
2.67 instead of 2.66).

Switch the quantize call to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values
round to the nearest even cent, matching FIN-212 and the test suite.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

`src/money.py`'s `round_money` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per **FIN-212**) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so half-cent values rounded up instead of to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665` → `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- Switched `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, plus the corresponding import.

## Testing
- CI run on this branch: passed (run `ci-0001`).
- `test_half_even` now passes: `2.675 → 2.68` (nearest even), `2.665 → 2.66` (nearest even).

Fixes: FIN-212
